question: How is the recitation connected to Sundarī, the lady of the worlds?
premises: The instruction involves having recited this element.
The address is to the lady of the gods.
Sundarī is identified as the lady of the worlds.
inference: The recitation is performed in relation to Sundarī, the lady of the worlds.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of tvidaṃ and the relation between sundaryā and bhuvaneśvarī are compressed in this verse.
plain_english: But having recited this, O lady of the gods, of Sundarī, the lady of the worlds.
